findings.failure_mode: any absent or permission-denied file aborts the entire program instead of returning a typed error
findings.fix: return Result<Vec<Record>, io::Error> and use fs::read_to_string(path)? or .map_err with a domain error type

findings.problem: parts[0].parse::<u32>().unwrap() as u16 - unwrap on parse and lossy as cast
findings.failure_mode: non-numeric content panics; a u32 value exceeding u16::MAX silently truncates via lossy cast
findings.fix: use u16::from_str or u32::try_from followed by .try_into() to u16 with proper error propagation; return Result

findings.problem: parts[0] and parts[1] are accessed via unchecked indexing with no bounds verification
findings.failure_mode: a line with fewer than 2 comma-separated fields causes a panic on out-of-bounds access
findings.fix: use split_once(',') or .get(0) and .get(1) with Option handling, or iterator .next()/.nth(1) with explicit None fallback

findings.problem: println!("loaded {}", parts[0]) - I/O side effect embedded in data-parsing pipeline
findings.failure_mode: pure data transformation leaks console logging; breaks determinism and makes the core function untestable in isolation
findings.fix: move all println! to the imperative shell layer; the pure core function should return data only with no side effects

findings.problem: load_sensors mixes I/O (fs::read_to_string, println), parsing, and domain construction in a single public function
findings.failure_mode: no pure testable core exists; the entire pipeline is coupled to filesystem access and console I/O
findings.fix: extract a pure fn parse_records(lines: impl Iterator<Item=&str>) -> Result<Vec<Record>, ParseError> and keep the shell function for fs reads and logging

findings.problem: Record has no invariants - any String and any u16 are valid, including empty names and zero values that may be semantically invalid
findings.failure_mode: downstream code cannot assume Record is semantically meaningful; invalid records propagate silently
findings.fix: use a private-constructor Record with a fallible fn try_new(name: &str, value: u16) -> Result<Record, RecordError> that rejects empty names and enforces domain invariants

findings.problem: .map(|part| part.trim().to_string()).collect() allocates a full Vec<String> for intermediate parsed parts
findings.failure_mode: unnecessary heap allocation on every line; a single malformed line wastes all intermediate allocations before panicking on the next unwrap
findings.fix: use split_once(',') to get exactly two parts, trim each, and construct the Record without collecting into Vec<String>

findings.problem: as u16 cast from u32 is lossy - values 65536..=u32::MAX silently wrap
findings.failure_mode: sensor value 70000 becomes 14464 without any error or warning, corrupting domain data
findings.fix: use u32::try_into().map_err(|_| RecordError::ValueOutOfRange) or parse directly as u16 with u16::from_str
